description: This file defines the DialogDispatcher class, which manages dialog interactions (accept/dismiss) within the Playwright core server. It extends a Dispatcher class and communicates dialog events and actions to other parts of the framework.

classes.name: DialogDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that wraps a Dialog object to facilitate communication between the browser dialogs and the test framework or automation script.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a DialogDispatcher with the scope (browser context) and the dialog object, setting up necessary properties and inheritance.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the dialog, optionally with prompt text, and handles progress updates.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the dialog and handles progress updates.

ctags.name: DialogDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class DialogDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Dialog, channels.DialogChannel, BrowserContextD/
